headline: rxe climbs from 1,334th to 52nd on ARC-2

sections.text: rxe gained 17.50 points to reach 47.36, moving from 1,334th to 52nd on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The jump carries rxe into the top 100 after starting the day in the four-digit ranks. Public standings remain provisional.
